hypothesis: Market-margin removal and fixed league/home/draw corrections improve retrospective market accuracy and probability quality.
data: ARCHIVE/events.jsonl.gz, match-winner market only, complete 2/3-way settled non-refund, one winning outcome; prices and receipt time not authenticated. Existing data exposed, not blind.
split: Sort unique kickoff timestamps; first 60% train, next 20% validation, last 20% test, timestamp groups kept together; retain all same-event observations in same split.
algorithms: Power solves sum(q^k)=1; Shin solves standard insider z equation; additive-logit shifts all binary logits by same constant to sum 1; corrected variants fit multinomial logit offsets with L2=10 on training, per league and side, then freeze.
selection: Select minimum validation log loss among all eight, ties by listed order. Test evaluated once; no candidates added.
metrics: test n, coverage, log loss, multiclass Brier, accuracy, unit-stake ROI, paired week bootstrap 95% CIs accuracy and ROI vs proportional; Holm correction across eight candidates; calibration bins league, odds, home/away/draw, 2/3-way; vote 9:1 only genuinely matched votes, no invented votes.

bootstrap.multiple_testing: Holm across eight two-sided paired bootstrap p values

leakage: feature whitelist odds, market, league, side, kickoff only; reject postgame and final odds as certified pregame features; labels only train fitting and evaluation; heldout labels flipped before training/prediction must yield identical coefficients/predictions.
verification: Commit inputs and hashes; offline replay; independent second settlement and metrics exact agreement; tests and full pytest.
prior: PR402 market and fixed 9:1 tied 57.52% on strict 492, PR403 common-temperature argmax unchanged; PR425 later KBO underperformed. No prior result is blind or causal.
